# Table

> Responsive data table for lists, comparisons, and structured records.

This file matches the installed `table` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/table.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/table.md`.

- `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`

- `core`
- `scroll-area`

## Composition

### Anatomy

```tsx
<Table>
  <TableCaption />
  <TableHeader>
    <TableRow>
      <TableHead />
    </TableRow>
  </TableHeader>
  <TableBody>
    <TableRow>
      <TableCell />
    </TableRow>
  </TableBody>
  <TableFooter>
    <TableRow>
      <TableCell />
    </TableRow>
  </TableFooter>
</Table>
```

### Clickable rows

TableRowLink turns the whole row into its hit area: the row paints --cui-table-row-hover-background on hover and the focus ring while the link has focus. It renders a button; pass render={<a href />} to navigate. Other buttons, links, and checkboxes in the row stay clickable above it.

```tsx
<Table>
  <TableBody>
    <TableRow>
      <TableCell>
        <TableRowLink />
      </TableCell>
    </TableRow>
  </TableBody>
</Table>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCaption,
  TableCell,
  TableFooter,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
  TableRowLink,
} from "@/components/control-ui/ui/table";
import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography";

const invoices = [
  { id: "INV-001", status: "Paid", method: "Credit Card", amount: "$250.00" },
  { id: "INV-002", status: "Pending", method: "PayPal", amount: "$150.00" },
  { id: "INV-003", status: "Unpaid", method: "Bank Transfer", amount: "$350.00" },
];

export function PrimitiveTableExample() {
  const [openInvoiceId, setOpenInvoiceId] = useState<string>();
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-lg">
      <Table>
        <TableCaption>A list of your recent invoices.</TableCaption>
        <TableHeader>
          <TableRow>
            <TableHead>Invoice</TableHead>
            <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
            <TableHead>Method</TableHead>
            <TableHead className="text-right">Amount</TableHead>
          </TableRow>
        </TableHeader>
        <TableBody>
          {invoices.map((invoice) => (
            <TableRow key={invoice.id} data-state={openInvoiceId === invoice.id ? "selected" : undefined}>
              <TableCell>
                <TableRowLink onClick={() => setOpenInvoiceId(invoice.id)}>
                  <Text weight="medium">{invoice.id}</Text>
                </TableRowLink>
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell>{invoice.status}</TableCell>
              <TableCell>{invoice.method}</TableCell>
              <TableCell className="text-right">
                <Text numeric>{invoice.amount}</Text>
              </TableCell>
            </TableRow>
          ))}
        </TableBody>
        <TableFooter>
          <TableRow>
            <TableCell colSpan={3}>Total</TableCell>
            <TableCell className="text-right">
              <Text numeric>$750.00</Text>
            </TableCell>
          </TableRow>
        </TableFooter>
      </Table>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Knobs

Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin.

### table

- `--cui-table-background`: `transparent`
- `--cui-table-foreground`: `var(--foreground)`
- `--cui-table-border-color`: `var(--border)`
- `--cui-table-border-width`: `var(--control-rim-width)`
- `--cui-table-cell-padding`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 2)`
- `--cui-table-head-height`: `var(--control-h-lg)`
- `--cui-table-row-hover-background`: `oklch(from var(--foreground) l c h / 0.03)`
- `--cui-table-row-selected-background`: `oklch(from var(--foreground) l c h / 0.05)`
- `--cui-table-header-foreground`: `var(--muted-foreground)`
- `--cui-table-footer-background`: `oklch(from var(--foreground) l c h / 0.03)`
- `--cui-table-header-sticky-background`: `var(--background)`
- `--cui-table-header-sticky-shadow`: `inset 0 calc(var(--cui-table-border-width) * -1) 0 var(--cui-table-border-color)`
